description.p: Omnimark renders Markdown the way you expect from the web, natively on your desktop:

ul.li: GitHub Flavored Markdown, footnotes, alerts and front matter
Syntax highlighting with line numbers for hundreds of languages
Diagrams and charts from code blocks: Mermaid, Graphviz, Vega-Lite, WaveDrom, nomnoml, ABC music, CSV tables
Split editor with synchronized scrolling and live reload
Folder sidebar, outline, search, and PDF/HTML export
